findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Grp.lean:41` defines `GrpObj`; `:81` defines bundled `Grp`; `:105` gives `Category (Grp C)`; `:122` gives `Grp.hom_ext`; `:137` and `:146` give `Grp.ofHom`/`Grp.homMk''`. `mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Mon.lean:518-553` defines the same `Hom`/`mk'`/`id`/`comp` structure over `IsMonHom` that this file restates at lines 48-83.

findings.issue: `AbelianVariety.Hom`, `Hom.mk'`, `Hom.id`, `Hom.comp`, and the category instance duplicate Mathlib's bundled group-object morphism API.

summary: The PR builds a parallel category of group-object morphisms for abelian varieties instead of inducing it from Mathlib's existing bundled `Grp` category.
